system.description:
• Effect: Fire two arrows in place of the one attack your action gives you.
  • Extra Attack, an off-hand weapon and Flowing Strikes add nothing to it: a Twin Nock is two arrows (three from 17th) and no more.
  • The second arrow is rolled with Disadvantage until 10th level, and from 10th level there is no penalty.
  • Can split between two targets within range, or fire both at the same target.
  • Each arrow gets your Bow Mastery bonus.
  • Cannot combine with Running Shot's advantage on the same turn until 13th level (see Loosed in Passing) — until then, choose one or the other each turn: move-and-shoot for advantage, or plant your feet for two arrows.

activities.name: Twin Nock
activities.text: Arrows in place of the one attack your action gives you, at one target or split; each gets your Bow Mastery bonus. Extra Attack, an off-hand weapon and Flowing Strikes add nothing. Until 13th level you cannot also have Running Shot's Advantage this turn.
